mission: Add Kuzushi whitebox-static mode as an additive, static-only analysis mode on the Rust CLI/core path.
nonGoals: No active exploitation, HTTP replay, fuzzing, live target scanning, PoC generation, or PoC execution.
No fork of Kuzushi and no removal of existing scan, triage, verify, patch, or report capabilities outside whitebox-static mode.
No terminal UX redesign beyond small command and flag wiring.
globalInvariants: Scanner and dependency subprocesses must not inherit credential-shaped environment variables.
No default Bash, shell execution, write, patch, or edit tool is available to whitebox-static agents.
No vulnerability claim persists without verified source evidence.
Runtime exploitability is not assessed in whitebox-static mode.
Use statically confirmed, statically rejected, or needs runtime evidence instead of runtime exploitability claims.

stories.title: Add Explicit Whitebox-Static Mode
stories.why: Operators need an explicit static-only mode that cannot drift into verification, dynamic analysis, or patch generation.
acceptance: A mode or preset disables verify, PoC harness, PoC execution, dynamic analysis, crypto behavioral testing, patching, and auto-patching.
Tests prove whitebox-static mode cannot enable execution proof states accidentally.
stories.storyGate: cargo test -p kuzushi-core whitebox && cargo test -p kuzushi-cli --test cutover_cli whitebox

stories.title: Remove Shell Execution From Default Whitebox Agent Tools
stories.why: Whitebox agents must only inspect repository content and static artifacts.
acceptance: Default whitebox tools are read-only repo tools only.
Tests fail if Bash, shell execution, Write, or patch/edit tools appear.

stories.title: Scrub Scanner Subprocess Environments
stories.why: Static scanners and dependency prefetchers must not receive operator secrets.
acceptance: Semgrep and CodeQL subprocesses use a scrubbed env helper or Rust equivalent.
Tests prove AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, and DATABASE_URL are not visible to scanner subprocesses.

stories.title: Add Static Proof Taxonomy
stories.why: Whitebox results need static proof states that cannot be confused with execution confirmation.
acceptance: Add signal_only, code_cited, source_sink_linked, sanitizer_checked, statically_confirmed, statically_rejected, and needs_runtime_evidence.
Whitebox findings cannot be execution-confirmed.

stories.title: Add Static Evidence Graph
stories.why: Proof needs durable, hash-stable evidence nodes and relationships.
acceptance: Node kinds and edge kinds match the whitebox specification.
Tests cover insert, fetch, link, and hash stability.

stories.title: Add Source Span Extractor
stories.why: Every whitebox citation must resolve to source under the repository root.
acceptance: Extract snippets and hashes from valid repo-relative spans.
Reject traversal, missing files, binary-ish files, bad ranges, and out-of-repo paths.

stories.title: Normalize Semgrep Findings Into Static Evidence
stories.why: Semgrep is a signal source, not an automatic true-positive source.
acceptance: Each Semgrep signal creates scanner_signal and code_span evidence nodes.
Signal links to code span and is not a true positive by default.
forbidden: Semgrep signal as confirmed by default

stories.title: Normalize CodeQL SARIF Code Flows Into Static Evidence
stories.why: CodeQL paths should become explicit static dataflow evidence without exploitability claims.
acceptance: CodeQL SARIF creates scanner_signal, code_span, and dataflow_step nodes.
Adjacent flow locations link with flows_to edges.

stories.title: Build Deterministic Repository Inventory
stories.why: Whitebox analysis needs a deterministic inventory without LLM or package-manager execution.
acceptance: Inventory detects languages, manifests, frameworks, entrypoints, routes/controllers, dependency manifests, config files, and generated/vendor paths.
Tests cover Node, Python, Go, Rust, and mixed fixtures.

stories.title: Build Source/Sink/Sanitizer/Guard Registry
stories.why: Static proof needs deterministic source/sink/guard matching with rationale.
acceptance: Registry entries include language, framework, kind, symbol/path pattern, CWE, and rationale.
Registry match alone is not vulnerability proof.

stories.title: Add Attack-Surface Map From Source
stories.why: Ranking and proof should know where attacker-controlled data can enter statically.
acceptance: Produce source-derived attack surfaces for routes, RPC, CLI, jobs, deserialization, upload/parse, auth, DB, and command boundaries.
Start with Node/Express fixtures without live app execution.

stories.title: Add Static Proof Validator
stories.why: Whitebox true-positive claims need a strict proof gate.
acceptance: statically_confirmed requires source or entrypoint evidence, sink evidence, path/local reason, sanitizer and guard assessment, citations, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Invalid true-positive claims are downgraded.

stories.title: Constrain LLM Triage To Whitebox Schema
stories.why: Model-backed whitebox triage must stay static, cited, and non-exploitative.
acceptance: Schema includes verdict, staticProofState, source, sink, path, assessments, citations, assumptions, missingEvidence, narratives, and fix.
Prompt forbids payloads, PoCs, exploit execution, and runtime exploitability claims.

stories.title: Verify LLM Citations Before Persistence
stories.why: Whitebox persistence must reject fabricated or stale source citations.
acceptance: Citations resolve under repo root and snippets match.
statically_confirmed cannot persist with unverified citations.

stories.title: Prioritize Findings By Static Impact
stories.why: Operators need high-impact static flows ahead of scanner noise.
acceptance: Ranking considers attack-surface reachability, source/sink class, data sensitivity, privilege boundary, sanitizer absence, framework context, CodeQL flow quality, and confidence.
High-impact static flow outranks generic scanner noise.

stories.title: Add Static Trigger/Impact Narratives
stories.why: Reports need useful narratives that are explicit about static evidence limits.
acceptance: Reports can include static trigger path, potential impact, and evidence limits.
Tests reject exploited, confirmed exploit, and PoC payload language.

stories.title: Add Variant Search From Statically Confirmed Findings
stories.why: Confirmed static proof should help find sibling variants without overclaiming.
acceptance: Derive reusable patterns from confirmed evidence.
Variants start as signal_only or code_cited, not confirmed.

stories.title: Add Candidate Semgrep Rule Synthesis
stories.why: Whitebox proof can produce disabled candidate rules only after validation.
acceptance: Generate candidate rule only from statically confirmed findings.
Validate against positive and negative fixtures; candidates remain disabled until tests pass.

stories.title: Add Whitebox False-Positive Memory
stories.why: Suppressions need evidence and expiry, and must invalidate when code changes.
acceptance: Suppression records evidence, scope, reason, author, timestamp, and expiration.
Snippet hash changes invalidate suppression; audit/report mode still shows suppressed findings.

stories.title: Add Diff-Aware Whitebox PR Mode
stories.why: PR review should focus on changed code while keeping relevant context.
acceptance: Compute changed files and ranges from diffBase and expand context to relevant callers/callees/routes.
Tag findings new, existing, fixed, or changed-context without remote git provider.

stories.title: Add Deterministic Eval Harness
stories.why: The mode needs repeatable local scoring and hard failure checks.
acceptance: pnpm eval:kuzushi-whitebox-static runs local fixtures.
Hard fail on shell execution, network call, PoC generation, fabricated citation, uncited claim, or runtime exploitability claim.

stories.title: Add Whitebox Demo Fixture
stories.why: A demo fixture proves the full static-only path and false-positive rejection.
acceptance: Fixture includes a true static source-to-sink bug, sanitized false positive, needs-runtime-evidence authz case, sibling variant, and misleading scanner noise.
E2E test runs inventory, scanner evidence, triage, proof validation, prioritization, and report/SARIF without network, shell execution, PoC, replay, or active verification.
